surface: SUNNYVAiLE LIBRAiRY / ChatGPT Guide complete manuscript

readerContract.humanQuestion: How do I set up and use ChatGPT well, choose the right current model and effort, give it the context and rules it needs, make useful things, and check what it produces on Free or paid plans?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: A nontechnical reader can orient to ChatGPT, choose Chat, Projects, Work or Codex, select Luna, Terra, Sol or Astra when available, direct complete jobs with practical prompts and recover from errors without assuming paid access or technical knowledge.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No AI vocabulary, coding knowledge, paid plan, model picker or previous ChatGPT setup is assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: ChatGPT works best as a directed collaborator: the surface controls where it works, the model supplies capability, effort changes reasoning, the plan changes access and capacity, and the brief, context, permissions and checks govern the job.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: A real leadership proposal built from rough notes, an approved brief and a spreadsheet makes hidden source authority, cross-file consistency and verification failures visible. Newsletters, photo collections and media plans provide distinct transfer jobs without pretending that readers need a website.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A standalone friendly field guide and reference, not a feature catalogue, prompt dump or advertisement.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I know what to click, what to provide, which current option fits, what applies to my plan and how to inspect the real result.

canonicalTruth.freshnessTrigger: Before publication or any product/model/plan change.
Any change to official prompting, context, permission, Skill or surface guidance.
Any change to Chat, Work, Codex, Projects, settings or plan access.
Any Astra, model-ladder or effort change.
Any change to the guide job, Free/paid rule or reader architecture.
Any change to public prose rules.

strengthsToUse: Separate verified fact, tested observation and unknown account variation.
End sections with a feasible action.
patternsNotToCopy: Do not repeat an FAQ shape.
Do not turn the whole book into cards.

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: Introduce names at the reader's decision point and keep lookup material separate.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: The chapters follow complete jobs rather than alphabetic features.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: Vary form by job: narrative, comparison, procedure, diagnosis and reference.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: Only plan boundaries repeat where they change access.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: Use a familiar example only when it preserves and exposes the mechanism.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: The proposal's approved brief and spreadsheet reveal authority and consistency failures; any Rewind Era reference must perform an equally specific teaching job.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: No Rewind detail without a teaching job.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: Every selected period object carries a constraint, source or consequence.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Explain how context, authority, tools, effort, permissions and checks change the output.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: Every workflow traces input through action to observable evidence.

genericAction.producerGuard: Include exact starting material, prompt, check and repair.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: Each core chapter leaves a copyable bounded move.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Describe the ordinary need before the product term.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: Chat, Work, Codex, context, Skill and agent labels follow plain meanings.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Reconnect every setting and model choice to a complete job.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: The opening case supplies the book's shared operating loop.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Use candid colleague-to-colleague prose and earned wit.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: Consequences and recovery replace compliance lectures.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: Use several distinct transfer jobs rather than one workshop as the product definition.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: Writing, research, files, building and media decisions all appear.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Open each substantial section on the human job or consequence.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: Separate case facts from transferable operating rules.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: Every worked case ends with what travels and what does not.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Write for a capable adult beginner, not a developer blog.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: Technical detail appears only when it changes a choice or check.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Begin with the account and simplest surface available, define a bounded job, supply authoritative context, choose the lowest model and effort likely to finish it, inspect the real result and repair only proven defects.
causalSequence: Setup and privacy determine what may enter.
The desired output determines Chat, Project, Work or Codex.
Context and authority determine what information can win.
Model and effort determine how much capability is applied.
Tools and permissions determine what can happen.
Inspection and repair determine whether the result is usable.
A saved rule or Skill earns its place only after the workflow works.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: Turn rough notes, an approved brief and a spreadsheet into a leadership-ready proposal containing a short presentation, speaker notes, a one-page summary and an email draft. The case anchors source authority, model and effort choice, cross-output consistency, artifact inspection and targeted repair.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A community newsletter, photo archive and media plan each test a different context, privacy, file or tool decision. Codex appears only in a separate honest workflow for a reader who actually has a website, app or repository.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Complete one real permitted job using the book's brief, plan boundary and evidence check, then save only the instruction that prevented an observed repeat failure.

analogyPlan.concept: Model, effort, surface and plan differ.
analogyPlan.analogy: Engine, working time, workshop and allowance.
analogyPlan.mapping: One familiar element maps to one product choice.
analogyPlan.limit: The comparison does not predict correctness or make paid access authoritative.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: It stops four controls from collapsing into better or worse ChatGPT.

humourPlan.lessonJob: Use High effort is a setting, not a tiara after the effort mechanism; let confident-but-wrong artifact moments supply restrained irony elsewhere.

draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Orientation and settings; surfaces; context and instructions; prompting; current models and efforts; files/search/research; tools/permissions/Skills; complete writing, research, file and build workflows; checking and repair; troubleshooting; Free/paid quick chooser; dated source appendix.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: The book is a connected field guide with selective tables, not a repeated feature-card stack or prompt catalogue.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Make hidden product choices visible through their effect on familiar work while retaining reference lookup.

humanQuestion.reason: Readers need to finish a real job.
humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: Open chapters with a recognisable need.

usefulCuriosity.reason: A polished summary can disagree with the artifact.
usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Invite inspection before revealing the defect.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: Context, memory, permissions and effort are hidden.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: Trace each through an exact source-to-result case.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: Product terms should answer existing questions.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Move from ordinary output needs to labels.

limitationsConsequences.reason: Plan and tool differences create real boundaries.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: Show Free, paid and no-equivalent routes beside the method.

humourSurprise.reason: Earned wit makes selection rules memorable.
humourSurprise.plannedEvidence: Retain the tiara line after the mechanism.

betterNextQuestion.reason: Recovery depends on asking what still contains the old fact.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: Close workflows with an observable recheck.

explanationArc.adaptation: Reference chapters answer first, then expand only as far as the reader's action needs.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: A long guide could become a stale feature catalogue, hide paid-only controls or overwhelm the reader with product vocabulary.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Replace the rejected reunion demonstration with the leadership-proposal workflow, then add complete distinct chapters whose current claims bind to the refresh ledger and whose workflows include exact inputs, prompts, checks and repairs.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: A new reader can orient, choose a route, complete a useful job, explain the model/effort choice and catch a source or artifact failure without paid access.
